method.cost: Jaccard distance on canonical precursor sets
method.tie_rule: entries with C >= 2*lambda bounded at 0 (indifference -> destroy+create)
method.noise_floor: two disjoint before-model subsamples of size n_f = min(n, N_before//2); new-support reference = before-model samples minus the held-out floor subsample
method.secondary_solver: POT sinkhorn_unbalanced sinkhorn_stabilized reg=0.05 reg_m=lambda, rep 0 only

s5_floor_caveat: S5's before-model (Corpus SFT) has 32 samples/target, so its noise floor uses two disjoint 16-sample halves (n_f=16) and a 16-sample new-support reference.
